title: Xdrip g6 - state not known
body: I'm struggling to get my transmitter to pair. It's on no more than 79 days and have been trying with dexcom app and separately on xdrip. Been trying on and off all day and message on dexcom is 'transmitter can't be found and xdrip is constantly saying 'state not known. Transmitter isn't showing on Bluetooth settings. I've not had any problems till now - does it sound like the transmitter has failed? Thanks
